comment.body: Thanks for the concrete report about VSCode started from Run doesn't see user environment variables, including the version, affected PowerToys area, and observed behavior. The remaining ambiguity is the exact failing path or whether this still reproduces on a current build, so a generic checklist would not help. Please confirm whether this still reproduces on the latest stable PowerToys, whether restarting PowerToys changes the user PATH, and whether the same VS Code launch from Command Palette sees the user PATH. This will distinguish the competing triage paths and determine whether the proposed fix should target the reported behavior or a different configuration or lifecycle condition.
